Definition: from G1909 and the base of G939; to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive:--come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship.
BiblicalUsage: Epibaino means to mount, to embark, to go aboard — to step up onto something that will carry you. Tell the daughter of Sion, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass; Paul finds a ship sailing to Phenice and goes aboard; and the prisoners embark for Italy.
TheologicalSignificance: The King rides a borrowed ass and Paul boards a ship he does not command, and both are carried exactly where God intends. I hold that mounting up is an act of trust, and the mount — ass or ship — is God's provision, not mine.
RelatedEvents: Triumphal Entry; Paul Shipwrecked on Malta
